name: Mod Thought & Lit (MA)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
Master of Arts (current MTL-Ph.D. students)
The Master of Arts (MA) is available to students admitted to the doctoral program who have not previously been awarded an MA. Students are not accepted into the Ph.D. program to earn a terminal MA degree. Candidates for the PhD who satisfy the committee of their progress and satisfactorily complete at least 45 units of coursework forming a coherent program of study may apply for an MA in Modern Thought and Literature.
Degree Requirements (Coterm)
The candidate for the MA (Coterm) must complete at least 45 units of graduate work, to be divided in the following manner:

• The introductory seminar, MTL 334A Concepts of Modernity I, for five units; in the event of a scheduling conflict, students may substitute MTL 334B with the director of graduate studies' prior permission

• 3 quarters of MTL 334D Master's Thesis work with the student's advisor, taken for 1 unit in the Autumn, Winter and Spring of the student's coterm conferral year

• At minimum, 4 courses taken for at least 3 units and letter grade, of advanced coursework in literature to be approved by the director of graduate studies

• At minimum, 4 courses taken for at least 3 units and letter grade, advanced coursework in a coherent and individually arranged interdisciplinary program, to be approved by the director of graduate studies
rules.notes: Students should take additional courses, approved by the advisor and the Director of Graduate Studies, to meet the minimum total units required for the degree.

rules.name: MA path

children.name: Introductory Seminar (MTL 334A, or MTL 334B with permission)
Three quarters of MTL 334D (1 unit each)
Master's Thesis Project and oral presentation, approved by the advisor and a second reader
Four approved advanced literature courses (3+ units, letter grade)
Four approved advanced interdisciplinary courses (3+ units, letter grade)
Current MTL PhD students: 45 units forming a coherent program, and the committee satisfied with your progress

rules.notes: Note: subtitles of the above courses change each year, but the course numbers stay the same.

reviewNotes: There are two ways to this MA. A current Modern Thought and Literature PhD student may apply for it after 45 units of coursework that form a coherent program, once the committee is satisfied with their progress; that is checked by hand. A coterm student needs 45 graduate units: the introductory seminar (MTL 334A, or MTL 334B with the director of graduate studies' permission) for 5 units, three quarters of MTL 334D, and four advanced literature courses and four advanced interdisciplinary courses, each for at least 3 units and a letter grade and approved by the director of graduate studies, which you move in. The Master's Thesis Project and its oral presentation are checked by hand.
